core_obligations: Let phi : A -> B be a rig-flat arrow of WAdm^Noeth and let A -> C be adic and topologically of finite type. Then C -> B (completed tensor)_A C is rig-flat.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to naive rig-flatness after replacing C by its localizations C_{f} (carried).

Case C finite over A (in particular surjective): B (tensor)_A C equals the completed tensor by algebra-lemma-completion-tensor, and naive rig-flatness follows from algebra-lemma-flat-base-change (carried).

General case: for a rig-closed prime q of B{x} over the rig-closed p = A cap q (intermediates rig-closed by delivered L48108), use the two local diagrams; the horizontal arrows are (faithfully) flat as localizations-completions of Noetherian rings, the left vertical arrow is flat by naive rig-flatness, the completions of the horizontal arrows are isomorphisms by lemma-rig-closed-point-variables, and more-algebra-lemma-flat-completion concludes.
